scope: Sep 2026 through Sep 2027 inclusive; 13 supported sector groups and reusable triggers, not a promise to cover every industry or observance.
calendarInterpretation: SK2027 is an official public-service calendar: use actual dates only alongside the general SK statutory list; floating holidays and its employee-specific observed dates are not general shop rules.
Federal means federally regulated workplaces under the Canada Labour Code; not a claim all Canadian employers close.
Easter Monday, Christmas Eve and Boxing Day are not SK statutory holidays; Easter Monday is also absent from the ten Canada Labour Code general holidays.
Halloween source was available in search result; subsequent direct open returned 403. Date is October 31; do not imply statutory status.
The holiday sources were checked 2026-09-06. Recheck policy/classification when building the next-year publishing batch, and shop hours separately.
School breaks, local events, lunar faith dates and promotional dates beyond this verified set require organizer or official calendar evidence before scheduling.
